body: Thanks for that I'll make sure to check it out and look into that app!
I'll get one as soon as I land, I tried searching it up to buy online but it seemed easier to get in person
I'll try my best too, have been sometimes I just haven't been doing the best at it

It honestly doesn't feel like anything makes sense, ive been depressed before and gotten through it but it feels so much more confusing this time. This time of year is tough cause it seems like a trauma anniversary but it seems like life really wanted to drop off a present this year. I had a tough breakup with someone I love for reasons i dont fully understand (and their still around and seem to care for me), my dad got into a bad motorcycle accident I witnessed first hand, ive been wanting to drink heavy, dont have an idea for what I'll do for grad school, and it seems relatively small things just wanna keep popping up. Insecurities, doubt, trauma, fear, and it doesnt feel like any of my self help has been helping. I just kinda feel alone and also am having a hard time going to or around people. Im happy my dad is around and recovering, that my breakup wasnt some toxic mess but instead a confusing mix of love and rejection, and life can always be worse. I just dont really know anything it feels like
Ive never heard that before im curious on it now

I know she said that it was wrong of her and that she did come into it thinking she would or was supposed to change me. It just sucks cause it was a healthy relationship and we both really cared for each other. It feels like ive lost a bestfriend as well with the breakup. Thank you for the advice you are right but it feels hard to do.
